text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Elevated 5xx rate observed for inference-api (us-east1). Trigger: error-rate > 5% over 2m. PagerDuty notify sent to on-call.

ana (oncall): got the page, I'm on it. joining war room. :eyes:

raj (eng-sre): war room link up: https://warroom.redwood.com/r/INC-1856009999 — adding folks. I'm taking incident commander for initial triage.

ana (oncall): confirm I'm primary responder / owner for mitigation. Will collect impact & triage steps.

chris (product): quick high-level: are customers affected broadly or a subset (hosted vs dedicated)? any status page draft we can push?

lena (support): getting reports from two paid customers in us-east and a few trial accounts. All mention timeouts and 502/503s in generation calls.

raj (eng-sre): initial telemetry — spike in gRPC 13 errors from the inference frontends to runtime nodes in us-east1. 90th latency also bumped. Dedicated clusters appear isolated so far.

mike (infra): I see kernel OOM-killer events on node gpu-73 in us-east1 around 17:08 UTC, followed by kube restarts. `dmesg` shows nv_peer_memory errors. Possibly GPU driver/hardware flakiness.

ana (oncall): owner: ana (oncall) for customer comms & mitigation. IC: raj (eng-sre). Infra lead: mike. Support liaison: lena.

incident-bot: Pager acknowledged by ana (oncall) at 17:10 UTC.

ana (oncall): Mitigation plan step 1: move traffic away from us-east1 for hosted API while we investigate. Step 2: isolate and cordon affected node pool. Step 3: fallback to compatible smaller model variant for latency-sensitive routes.

raj (eng-sre): Executing node cordon now: `kubectl cordon gpu-73 -n inference-prod-us-east1`

mike (infra): cordon complete. Draining pod set to recreate onto healthy nodes: `kubectl drain gpu-73 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

ana (oncall): Routing change: set traffic-policy for inference-api hosted route to prefer us-west1 and eu-west1. Pushing config: `redwood route update inference-api --primary us-west1 --fallback eu-west1`

chris (product): Draft status page message (please confirm before posting):
```
Status: Degraded Service — Inference API (Hosted, us-east1)
Start time: 2026-03-15 17:08 UTC
Impact: Some hosted API requests in us-east1 may receive 5xx errors or elevated latency. Dedicated customers are currently unaffected.
Current status: Mitigation in progress — traffic is being routed away from affected nodes, and engineers are investigating root cause.
Next update: in 30 minutes or sooner.
```

lena (support): OK to post once we confirm routing change completed. I'll prep canned messages for affected customers (trial + paid).

ana (oncall): Posting to status page now (will paste link when live). Also sending customer notification for high-impact paid customers: short note + mitigation steps.

raj (eng-sre): brief internal note for war room: suspected GPU driver/hardware issue causing node restarts -> upstream 5xx. Looking at driver logs and NVidia stack. If we confirm, we should mark node for maintenance and avoid auto-replacement until we have a patch or node swap plan.

mike (infra): Flagging node pool for manual intervention. Opening infra ticket: INFRA-4821 (node gpu-73: hardware flake).

incident-bot: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/INC-1856009999 (posted by ana).

ana (oncall): customer notifications sent to the two paid accounts, cc'ing CSMs. Template used: `We are experiencing elevated errors for hosted inference in us-east1. We have routed traffic to alternate regions and are investigating. Our team will follow up with an incident report.`

lena (support): Received confirmation from one customer that errors dropped after routing change. Good sign.

raj (eng-sre): Next ops step: collect driver logs from gpu-73 and adjacent nodes, check kernel and nv_peer_memory traces. Command: `ssh infra@node-gpu-73 sudo journalctl -u nvidia-driver -o short-iso --since \"1 hour ago\" > /tmp/driver.log`

mike (infra): logs collected. Uploading to war room artifacts.

ana (oncall): Quick decisions: 1) keep routing skewed away from us-east1 until root cause confirmed; 2) do not autoscale back into affected node pool; 3) prepare post-incident customer email with timeline.

chris (product): I'll draft post-incident customer email and the internal RCA template. Ana, Raj — assign follow-ups for RCA owners after incident wraps.

ana (oncall): Handoff plan: if incident goes beyond 90 minutes, hand to day-shift SREs — Raj to lead the handoff; include infra ticket INFRA-4821 and war room link.

raj (eng-sre): Agreed. For now I'll stay on this but will escalate to hardware partner if driver traces point to firmware.

incident-bot: Next update scheduled in 25 minutes.

lena (support): Closing loop with support queue: flagging tickets with `incident:INC-1856009999` tag.
